g.text: Shared selected genes · diagonal = paper total

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172b3a

g.text: How the selected genes overlap published lists

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617481

g.text: 306 of 319 candidates occur in at least one imported publication list; 13 have no mapped membership in this registry.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Paper memberships annotate provenance; they are not admission requirements for the quantitative funnel. Tables from the same paper are deduplicated.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Matrix color = Jaccard overlap; numbers = gene counts. Targeted reports are included. Boel/BAGE has no resolved eligible locus in this registry.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Unmapped, noncoding and ambiguous entries do not silently become protein-coding candidates. Registry coverage is not all published literature.
